cases.translation: O my soul, praise the Lord!
cases.explain: Душа is the subject addressed directly (nominative case addressing the soul).

cases.translation: All my life I will praise the Lord.
cases.explain: Господа is the direct object of the transitive verb восхвалять (to praise), requiring the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Когда ___ покидает его, и он возвращается в землю.
cases.translation: When his spirit departs from him, and he returns to the earth.
cases.explain: Дух is the subject of the verb покидает (departs), requiring the nominative case.

cases.translation: Blessed is he to whom God of Jacob is a helper.
cases.explain: The genitive case Иакова after Бог (God) expresses possession: 'God of Jacob.'

cases.translation: He who created heaven and earth.
cases.explain: Небо is the direct object of the verb сотворивший (created), taking the accusative case.
Верность is the direct object of the verb хранит (keeps); accusative singular feminine equals nominative.

cases.translation: He defends the cause of the oppressed.
cases.explain: The genitive case угнетенных after дело (cause) indicates possession or association.
Чужеземцев is the direct object of the transitive verb хранит (preserves), requiring the accusative case.

reading.question: What does the psalmist command his soul to do?
reading.explain: Восхваляй means 'praise,' commanding the soul to praise the Lord.

reading.ru: Всю свою жизнь буду восхвалять Господа, буду петь хвалу моему Богу, пока я жив.
reading.question: How long does the psalmist commit to praising the Lord?
reading.explain: Всю свою жизнь (all my life) and пока я жив (while I live) indicate lifelong commitment.

reading.ru: Не надейтесь на правителей, на человека, в котором нет спасения.
reading.question: On whom should we not rely according to this verse?
reading.explain: The verse explicitly warns against trusting in правителей (rulers) and человека (man) without спасения (salvation).

reading.ru: Блажен тот, кому помощник Бог Иакова, кто надеется на Господа своего Бога, сотворившего небо и землю, море и все, что его наполняет.
reading.question: Who is blessed according to this verse?
options: Those who trust in the God of Jacob, who created heaven, earth, sea, and all within
reading.correct: Those who trust in the God of Jacob, who created heaven, earth, sea, and all within
reading.explain: The verse states that blessed is he whose helper is God of Jacob and who trusts in Him as creator.

reading.ru: Он защищает дело угнетенных, дает пищу голодным.
reading.question: What does the Lord do for the oppressed and hungry?
options: Defends their cause and provides food
reading.correct: Defends their cause and provides food
reading.explain: The verse states He защищает дело (defends the cause) of the угнетенных (oppressed) and дает пищу (gives food) to the голодным (hungry).

reading.ru: Господь царствует вовек, Твой Бог Сион во все поколения, Аллилуйя!
reading.question: For how long does the Lord reign?
reading.explain: Вовек (forever) and во все поколения (throughout all generations) emphasize God's eternal reign.
